description:
### Overview

A custom mod replacing Ashe with the Dread Retribution Arcana from Dota 2.

You can also preview the [Master of Madness](https://www.divineskins.gg/Dear_Agony/master-of-madness-ashe) style

---

### Assets

Hero: Drow Ranger from Dota 2

Model: Dread Retribution Arcana

Style: **Cold of Heart**

---

### Audio

Voice Lines: Completely new voice-over featuring 123 voice lines

Sound Effects: DRX Ashe

---

### Animations

The original Ashe animations have been replaced with 21 unique animations

---

### References

[Dread Retribution voice lines](https://dota2.fandom.com/wiki/Dread_Retribution_Bundle/Responses)

---

### Compatibility

Works with Base Skin
